answer.rationale: Current state: p99 write latency 5x target for 90 min, recent release 2 hrs ago, peak settlement traffic, heavy writes. Intervention options: rollback_release, regional_failover, add_capacity, enable_circuit_breaker, route_read_replicas. Need to verify 2 memories. memory_b5 (day 55) shows routing report queries to read replicas took dashboard load off primary; transactional write latency recovered same day. memory_b2 (day 33) shows regional failover restored latency fast during March degradation; traffic shifted cleanly and error rates recovered within minutes. Both are relevant. memory_b5 directly addresses write latency via read replica routing. memory_b2 shows regional failover can restore latency during degradation with clean traffic shift. Given peak settlement traffic and heavy writes, routing to read replicas (memory_b5) seems most targeted to reduce write path load while preserving writes. Regional failover (memory_b2) is also strong but may be broader than needed. I'll verify both to inform the decision.
